description: Calculates an ethanol blend for a fresh tank, existing fuel, correction, or ratio without authentication or account-data access. Percentages are 0–100 and all volumes use the selected unit. Source ethanol contents are measured values. Fresh mode requires finalVolume; existing mode requires finalVolume, currentVolume, and currentEthanol; correction mode requires tankCapacity, currentVolume, and currentEthanol; ratio mode requires no volumes.
name: calculate_ethanol_blend

status.description: Stable result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.
